title: Succession vocabulary -- what may become of a prior system's path, declared once (ADR-011)
description: The one home of every DISPOSITION a migration map may assign to a path of a host's prior agent system. Each disposition names the fields a row assigning it must carry, and what each field REFERS to; the interpreter checks a reference by its kind and holds no disposition by name. `undecided` names the state of a path no row answers -- a declared absence that no row may assign. A new disposition is a row here, never an edit to the interpreter.

carries.description: Every field a row with this disposition must carry, and nothing else it may carry.

refers.description: The kind of thing the value names; checked by the interpreter's reference registry.
